**Before Laminar → With Laminar **

### Stop Cleaning to a Worst-Case Timer

Your CIP loop doesn’t need more time — it needs better intelligence. Conductivity and timers force
every wash to run for the worst-case scenario, even when the line is clean minutes earlier. Result?
Lost capacity every cycle, every day.

### Start Cleaning to a Condition.

Our AI-powered sensors analyze the liquid’s spectral fingerprint to know the exact moment a final
rinse or wash meets your production line's cleaning requirements. ML models use real-time condition
data to automatically advance PLCs, eliminating chronic overwash and reclaiming valuable uptime.

**Before Laminar → With Laminar **

### Undetected CIP Underwash = Quality & Safety Risk

Stuck valves, cavitation, insufficient flow, operator errors, excessive soiling lead to failed CIP
loops that aren’t discovered until downstream — causing rewash, downtime, or worse, product holds
and safety events.

### CIP Underwash Detection is Built in

When our CIP ML model detects an underwash, it automatically extends the step till the effecting
cleaning condition is met. This prevents underwash and ensures that your cleaning requirements and
quality standards are met in every CIP cycle, across all your SKUs and production cycles.

**Before Laminar → With Laminar **

### CIP Overwash = Hidden Opex Drain

CIP waste isn’t just water. It’s heat, chemicals, energy, labor, and lost production hours. Across
hundreds of cycles, “safe overcleaning” quietly becomes one of your plant’s highest invisible costs.

### Save Resources in Every CIP Step

Conductivity sensors may help reduce clean-in-place chemical use but they don't go far enough. Our
clean-in-place solution not only adds to those savings but also reduces CIP process times by an
additional 15%+ and reduces water usage by 10%–20%. The result is cleaning procedures running your
CIP to a liquid condition, not just conductivity.

## FAQs

Find answers to the most common questions about Laminar's Clean-in-Place ML models & spectral
sensors.

Is Laminar's Clean-in-Place Optimization compatible with our existing PLC?

Laminar primarily serves [food and beverage manufacturing][27], dairy processing, brewing, and
pharmaceutical production. Our technology is designed for any facility using [Programmable Logic
Controllers (PLCs)][28], Distributed Control System (DCS), or OPC Servers — and running CIP
processes or needing real-time quality monitoring of liquid products.

No major changes are required to your CIP system. Laminar integrates with your existing PLC. The PLC
retains full control — Laminar sends optimization recommendations as simple signals that your PLC
acts on. You can enable or disable Laminar's recommendations at any time.

What's the ROI timeline?

Laminar's Insights dashboard shows both projected and actualized savings. Projected savings estimate
what you would save if the ML model's recommendations were fully adopted. Actualized savings reflect
real reductions after automation is enabled.

Many customers see measurable projected savings within the first month of data collection, before
automation is even enabled. Once our models are validated by your team and closed-loop automation is
enabled, actualized savings begin to accumulate immediately. ROI timelines vary by facility, but
customers with high CIP frequency, high water/energy costs, or significant product loss typically
see the fastest payback. During discovery, we can model expected savings based on your specific
operating conditions.

How much maintenance is required?

No routine maintenance is required. The CIP process that cleans your lines also keeps the sensor
face clear. We recommend periodic visual inspection of the outer housing to ensure the device hasn't
been dislodged or damaged. Remote calibration is done by our team lifting the burden of ongoing
maintenance from you.

What about Clean-in-Place validation/compliance?

Laminar's proprietary ML models are supervised models trained on your line’s data from both the
installed spectral sensors and your factory PLC. During a training period (typically 2-3 weeks),
data is passively collected to build models specific to your processes. Once trained, models deploy
first in evaluation mode — showing recommendations without triggering automation — so you can
validate performance before enabling real-time optimization.

Laminar sensors are FDA-compliant and carry BPE (Bioprocessing Equipment) certification, the
industry standard for pharmaceutical and biotech applications. Our technology assists with faster
corrective action that enhances your hygienic and Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).

# **Reduce Product Changeover Time by 20%**

[Beverage bottling line switching from one drink to another, with Laminar sensors detecting the
exact transition to minimize waste and downtime.”]

## The Hidden Costs of Every Manufacturing Changeover

### **Flushed Product From Changeover Process**

Rising SKU complexity demands shorter production runs, faster turnarounds, and tighter
orchestration. But every product changeover still carries hidden loss — product sent to drain before
the production line stabilizes. Preserving both schedule and yield requires changeovers driven by
precision, not guesswork.

### **More Product Changeover, Lower Productivity**

The luxury of production runs with just a single SKU per line is a thing of the past as consumer and
market demands change fast. Manufacturing processes like changeover drive up production costs and
hinder productivity with any slight increase to the amount of time it takes the production line to
switch from one SKU to the next.

### **Meeting Production Schedule with Small Batches**

Agile and efficient processes are key to managing schedules and cost reduction, especially when SKU
counts increase resulting in more production runs with shorter batches and greater variety. Meeting
your production goals and keeping up with demand is a fine balancing act.
[Laminar monitoring box mounted on a factory wall with connected cables, collecting and transmitting
live Clean-in-Place and changeover data.]

## Precise Production Process for Less Changeover Time

1/3

### **More Fillable Product, Less Product Loss**

Our Changeover & Product Loss Prevention models pinpoint safe cutover at the head and tail of the
process, advising the PLC to bottle good product (with rising input costs) and not flush it down the
drain.

### **Faster Changeovers, More Production Efficiency**

Laminar helps you reduce product loss and input costs by optimizing every production run across your
production line. Our Changeover ML models enable precise switches between SKUs. Our technology
enables the changeover process to run 15% to 20% faster. Every minute saved is a minute of extra
filling time, resulting in more product shipped per shift.

## **Run an Agile Manufacturing Facility**

Laminar helps you mitigate the operational challenge of running smaller batches and more production
runs to meet changing customers demands. With our changeover models, you gain the ability to run the
optimal changeover period with minimal product loss. Gain over 20% production speed and get more
production flexibility.

## Detect exact SKU changeover for every production run.

Laminar’s spectral sensors build unique spectral signatures within sub-seconds. Our ML models
instantly advise the PLC to take the right action.

Easy to install and integrate into your PLC/SCADA and network, the solution is designed to be up and
running within days, reporting efficiency and cost savings in real-time on our Insights platform.

# **Get More Product with Closed-loop Batch Optimization**

[Peanut butter being filled into jars on a production line, optimized by Laminar’s spectral sensors
and AI agents to ensure consistency and reduce waste.]

## The Challenges and Costs of Unoptimized Lines

### **Batch Turnover is Too Long**

Product consistency is key to quality, but frequent “inspecting in” with manual sampling extends
your processing times. Removing guesswork is critical to optimizing batch processing, turnover
rates, and batch cycle time.

### **Chasing the “Golden Batch”**

Producing golden batch quality every batch cycle is a challenge. Viscosity, homogeneity, ingredient
quality, and process consistency are all critical parameters that must be tuned right to ensure both
productivity, efficiency, and quality are optimal.

### **Batch Size Shrink**

Rising pressure to focus on input costs, efficiency, and productivity leaves less time to chase
losses and search for clarity on batch processing output variability by shift, line, or SKU. Still,
losing good product hinders output goals.
[Laminar Gateway device installed in a production environment, securely transmitting real-time data
from inline spectral sensors to Laminar AI agents that optimize CIP, changeovers, batch processes,
and quality monitoring.]

## Closed-Loop, Autonomous Optimization of Batch Operations

1/3

## **Know When it is Ready**

Laminar’s sensors and ML models for batch optimization monitor your batch processing, reducing the
number of samples required to check progression or completion. Laminar's batch quality assistance
speeds up every batch cycle in real-time.

# **Produce a “golden batch” every time**

Laminar’s sensors and ML for batch operations builds a unique digital signature that incorporates
all key batch parameters (viscosity, color, composition etc.) of a “golden batch” and compares it in
real-time to your current batch. Our ML models then take precise action for mid-batch corrections
when the batch is ready or alerts when the batch specs deviate from the set standard.

# **Produce more from every batch**

Clean-in-Place and Changeovers are necessary processes to maintain batch quality and meet demand,
but they are a root cause for product loss and downtime. Laminar’s sensors and ML model algorithms
send alerts to capture good product and improve your batch size and output instantly.

## Run Perfect Batches Every Time

Laminar’s spectral sensors, coupled with our purpose-built ML Models, build a distinct signature in
real-time of your batch composition that our AI Agent monitors.

You now have a view inside your equipment that transforms the way you run your batches. No more
guesswork and excessive sampling. More autonomous precision = more perfect batches every time.

# Inline Quality Monitoring

[Food and beverage products moving down a factory conveyor with Laminar’s spectral sensor data

## Stop Reactive Quality Control

### **Mistakes That Keep Happening**

Missing ingredients, stuck valves, incorrect dosing, insufficient operator training, shift-to-shift
variability… These don’t all happen at the same time, but they do keep happening, and it's
frustrating to whack-a-mole from a quality standpoint.

### **Sampling Heavy Quality Control**

Sampling is essential for ensuring quality, but it often slows down production—particularly when
underlying root causes remain unresolved. Excessive process and input variability lead to an
overreliance on inspection rather than prevention—a cycle that operations find tough to break.

### **Variability in Process and Inputs**

Even manufacturers with a limited number of “hero” SKUs face significant challenges from process and
input variability. For operations managing an expanding SKU portfolio, new suppliers, and evolving
formulations, the complexity—and the struggle to maintain consistency—erodes margins and
productivity.
[Laminar Gateway device mounted in a factory setting, linking inline spectral sensors on production
lines to Laminar’s AI platform for real-time process optimization.][Laminar spectral sensor in
production pipeline]

Our AI-powered sensors capture the spectral fingerprint of every product in your production line ,

changeovers, for cost accounting and regulatory compliance and audits.

# **Less Sampling, More Efficient InLine Quality Control**

precise, human-readable insights, they can sample less, trust the data more, and focus on driving
process innovation — all while ensuring every batch meets the highest quality inspection standards.

# **Drive Down Variability, Get More Out of Production**

Laminar’s inline quality control sensors track every parameter — from color and viscosity to

quality issues. Give your quality team the superpower to run smarter, faster, and more reliable
programs.

Paired with Agentic AI and edge ML models, they provide sub-second decisions that maintain quality

Unilever partnered with Laminar through the 100+ Accelerator to tackle inefficiencies in factory
cleaning. By deploying Laminar’s AI-driven in-line spectral sensing technology, Unilever reduced
cleaning times by 20%, cut utility use by 10%, and saved €100,000 per year at its Poznań, Poland
foods factory.

## Challenges Faced

Unilever’s Clean-in-Place (CIP) systems were designed to guarantee product safety but often led to
over-washing, excessive utility use, and lost production time. Traditional manual sampling made it
difficult to balance compliance with efficiency.

## Implemented Solutions
* Installed Laminar’s IoT-enabled spectral sensors in process lines to monitor cleaning cycles in
real time.
* Applied AI-powered analysis to identify over-washing and determine exactly when cleaning steps
were complete.
* Automated detergent, temperature, and duration settings — ensuring the right clean at the right
time.
* Enabled Unilever to move from manual checks and static protocols to dynamic, science-led
optimization.

> “AI insights from sensor data showed multiple examples of over-washing. It also identified when
> protocol said cleaning was complete and the data said it wasn’t.”

## Results
* 20% faster cleaning times, unlocking additional production capacity.
* 10% reduction in utility use, including water and energy.
* €100,000 annual savings per line at the Poznań foods factory.
* 16.7% faster changeovers year-over-year.
* Planned roll-out to 35 additional sites by 2026.

> “In our foods factory in Poznan, the system has reduced machine cleaning times by 20%, cut utility
> use by 10% and helped save €100,000/year.”

A leading fine chemicals manufacturer struggled with inconsistent product quality grading due to
reliance on grab sampling. By implementing Laminar’s in-line spectral sensing and AI-driven
analysis, the company unlocked continuous, touchless quality monitoring — saving $80,000 per year on
a single line.

## Challenges Faced

Product quality was defined by color and haze, but grab sampling delayed visibility and led to
inefficiencies. The company needed a way to measure and validate product quality in real time,
directly in the process line.

## Implemented Solutions
* Deployed **Laminar’s patented spectral sensors** directly in the process line for real-time,
continuous monitoring.
* Applied **AI-based analysis** to detect subtle changes in color and haze signatures.
* Automated quality grading into categories (Grade A = Clear, Grade B = Yellow tint, Grade C =
Orange tint).
* Enabled operators to make **immediate interventions** and optimize production in the moment.

## Results
* **$80,000 annual savings** per line by reducing off-grade product and minimizing waste.
* Continuous QA/QC without the delays and labor costs of grab sampling.
* Improved consistency and confidence in product grading.
* Scalable solution with applications across personal care, home care, beauty & wellbeing, dairy,
food & beverage, cosmetics, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals.

### Who we are

# Bridging Physical & Digital Worlds Through Innovation

Si-Ware Systems is a deep-tech innovation powerhouse that redefines how the world senses, processes,
and responds to the world around us. We develop and integrate cutting-edge sensing technologies—from
MEMS and optical components to embedded processing, AI, and intelligent software—that bridge the
physical and digital worlds to expand the boundaries of perception, automation, and
interaction—shaping the future of how humans, machines, and environments co-exist and evolve.

### What we do

## Delivering Scalable Sensing Solutions Built on Proprietary Technologies

Si-Ware delivers world-class sensing technologies, built on proprietary IPs in Material Sensing,
Inertial Sensing, Sensor Fusion, and Sensing Control SaaS. We offer OEM sensing components, advanced
sensing devices, sensor management software, and integrated end-to-end sensing solutions—available
as both standard products and custom-developed, fit-for-purpose solutions.

### Our History

## From an IC design house to an innovative Sensing technology powerhouse

With each breakthrough, we’ve added depth—advancing our technology stack while also strengthening
productization, cross-functional collaboration, and global execution capabilities.

## 2004

## 2005

IC chip design service provider

## 2007

MEMS based sensor & timing technology IP provider

## 2014

## 2019

## 2026

Portable, plug-and-play FT-NIR device for quick evaluation and prototyping of non-homogeneous

## **What Is **

## Si-NIR Matrix DVK

## **?**

Si-NIR Matrix development kit is a portable, plug&play FT-NIR platform that enables both evaluation
and prototyping of new solutions with advanced material analysis capabilities using the Si-NIR
Matrix sensor.

Designed for engineers and researchers working with real-world, non-homogeneous materials, it
provides a practical environment for quick experimentation, testing, and model development.
Featuring dual electrical interface options, the kit supports a smooth transition from feasibility
testing to functional prototypes and can be integrated into host systems for early-stage trials.

It includes all necessary hardware, accessories, software, and integration tools to make evaluation
and development efficient and straightforward.

## **Non-Destructive Material Analysis Capabilities**

Sample Types

**Homogeneous Solids**: powders, ground solids, textiles, fibers, thin films, plastic, and leaves

**Non-homogeneous solids**: granular solids, resins, blends, pellets

**Liquids**: opaque liquids or transparent liquids that contain particulates

Measurement Mode
Discrete
Sampling Method

- Diffuse reflectance

- Transflectance can be enabled with external accessories

# Bridging Physical & Digital Worlds Through Innovation

Si-Ware Systems is a deep-tech innovation powerhouse that redefines how the world senses, processes,
and responds to the world around us. We develop and integrate cutting-edge sensing technologies—from
MEMS and optical components to embedded processing, AI, and intelligent software—that bridge the
physical and digital worlds to expand the boundaries of perception, automation, and
interaction—shaping the future of how humans, machines, and environments co-exist and evolve.

# Looking for a great career?

#### We're seeking top-tier contributors.

## ABOUT US

Si-Ware Systems is the creator of the world’s smallest FT-NIR spectrometer—pushing the boundaries of
miniaturized sensing technology. Our founders are seasoned entrepreneurs backed by seasoned
investors. Our growing team is made up of a range of enthusiastic colleagues who thrive in a
fast-paced and challenging environment. Together, we’re enabling customers to get instant, accurate
insights wherever and whenever they need them.

**Seeking top-tier talent to join our team:**
* You will be surrounded by smart, hard-working and caring people.
* You will work in a professional and friendly environment.
* You will feel proud of the work you do every day.
* You will experience a truly supportive team culture.
* You will be part of a unique, dynamic, and cutting-edge company.
* You will have the chance to make a difference and positively affect lives.

## **About** us

We specialize in MEMS-based near-infrared spectral measurements and offer digital solutions,
including app and cloud platforms, for seamless data processing and analysis. This innovative
technology is used, for example, for rapid material and product identification. Spectral Engines is
a brand of m-u-t GmbH, which belongs to the Nynomic Group.

The Nynomic Group develops and manufactures non-contact optical measurement systems for a wide range
of industries, from agriculture and semiconductor manufacturing to medical technology, wood
processing, and fire detection. Its companies cover the entire value chain, from optical components
to turnkey solutions.

The companies of Nynomic AG include Avantes B.V., LayTec AG, tec5 AG, LemnaTec GmbH, Sensortherm
GmbH, m-u-t GmbH (with the Spectral Engines brand), Image Engineering GmbH & Co. KG, MGG
Micro-Glühlampen-Gesellschaft Menzel GmbH, NLIR ApS, Photecture Inc., and art photonics GmbH.

## **About** us

We specialize in MEMS-based near-infrared spectral measurements and offer digital solutions,
including app and cloud platforms, for seamless data processing and analysis. This innovative
technology is used, for example, for rapid material and product identification. Spectral Engines is
a brand of m-u-t GmbH, which belongs to the Nynomic Group.

The Nynomic Group develops and manufactures non-contact optical measurement systems for a wide range
of industries, from agriculture and semiconductor manufacturing to medical technology, wood
processing, and fire detection. Its companies cover the entire value chain, from optical components
to turnkey solutions.

The companies of Nynomic AG include Avantes B.V., LayTec AG, tec5 AG, LemnaTec GmbH, Sensortherm
GmbH, m-u-t GmbH (with the Spectral Engines brand), Image Engineering GmbH & Co. KG, MGG
Micro-Glühlampen-Gesellschaft Menzel GmbH, NLIR ApS, Photecture Inc., and art photonics GmbH.

relevant_companies.company_summary: TriOS is a leading manufacturer of high-quality optical measuring technology, specializing in spectral sensors designed for environmental and water monitoring applications. Their product range includes photometers, fluorometers, radiometers, and comprehensive monitoring systems, catering to diverse sectors such as environmental monitoring agencies, water treatment facilities, and marine research organizations. With a commitment to precision and innovation, TriOS provides robust solutions that enhance water quality management and support scientific research.

Abwasser

TriOS Sensoren werden vielfach für die Überwachung von Gewässern eingesetzt. Sie liefern genau und in Echtzeit Parameter wie Nitrat, Nitrit, Trübung und Öl in Wasser, und können damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Erkennung und Reduzierung von Umweltverschmutzungen leisten.

TriOS – Ihr Partner für spektrale Sensoren

TriOS ist ein langjährig am Markt etablierter Hersteller hochwertiger optischer Messtechnik. Bereits 1998 konnte sich das Unternehmen mit der Entwicklung des ersten, am Markt verfügbaren, spektralauflösenden Lichtmessgerätes für den Einsatz in der Meeresforschung, RAMSES, einen Namen machen und sich bis heute zu einem der führenden Hersteller im Bereich der optischen Tauchsensoren entwickeln. Neben Radiometern bietet TriOS auch Photometer, Fluorometer und diverse andere Sensoren an und ist somit ein unverzichtbarer Lieferant von hochwertigen Präzisionssonden in der Gewässergüte, Trink- und Abwasserüberwachung und in vielen Industrieanwendungsgebieten.

Produkte

Die TriOS Mess- und Datentechnik GmbH stattet bereits seit zwei Jahrzehnten Partner in Wissenschaft und Naturschutz mit hochqualitativen Messgeräten zur Umwelt- und Wasserüberwachung aus und legt großen Wert auf den stetigen Austausch mit Forschungspartnern und Anwendern. Die Expertise des Unternehmens entsteht gerade aus diesem Austausch und einem beständigen Drang nach Wachstum und Verbesserung. Obwohl unsere Wurzeln in der Radiometrie liegen, konnten wir unser Portfolio mit den Jahren in die Bereiche Photometrie, Fluorometrie, Nephelometrie und Elektrochemie ausweiten. Hierbei bieten wir unseren Kunden nicht nur einzelne Messsensoren, sondern ganze Systemkonstruktionen zum anwendungsgerechten Einsatz in diversen Bereichen an.

# About TriOS

For over two decades TriOS is equipping partners in science and nature conservation with
high-quality measuring devices for environmental and water monitoring and has always put great value
to the knowledge exchange with research partners and users. The company’s expertise stems from this
exchange and a constant desire for growth and improvement. Although our roots lie in radiometry, we
were able to expand our portfolio to the areas of photometry, fluorometry, nephelometry and
electrochemistry. We not only offer our customers single sensors but also whole system-constructions
for application-specific uses in various areas.

We are proud that not only our products contribute to research and preservation of the environment
but also our company that commits to sustainability and compensation of our own emissions.

TriOS unites all production stages on the company site in Rastede. Starting with research and
development, the production of components in the mechanics and electronics workshop up to the final
product design, all processes lie within the company. This is how an active exchange of information
and ideas across the departments can be lived and a great pool of ideas, creativity and competence
is created. Production materials of highest quality and a precise construction always have the
highest priority in all our process stages.

Discover the variety of the TriOS product range and convince yourself of the high quality of all our
products.

## Company History

The company has its origins in the University of Oldenburg. This is where the first ideas about the
pilot-product RAMSES came up. By now a team of 60 employees is working on research and development,
production and marketing of the products on over 4000 square meters. It has always been of high
importance for us to offer the highest quality and to stay in harmony with nature itself. All
production stages are located on the company site in Rastede.

## History

1998
Foundation

Founded as a University Spin-off

1999
First office

First office on 150m² in Oldenburg

2002
Office expansion

Office expansion to 450m²

2008
Nano Technology

Introduction of Nano Technology to improve the quality of the sensors

2011
New Headquarters in Rastede

Opening of new Headquarters on 1400+700m² in Rastede

2014
Establishment of active sales division
2015
Expansion and Awards

Expansion of production and logistics by further 2500m²

Awarded with the European Business Award as National Champion in the category "enviromental and
corporate sustainability"

2016
More awards

Awarded with the European Business Award as National Champion in the category "growth strategy"

2019
Continued company growth

New buildings added to the facilities.
Number of employees: ~90.

2024
Foundation

Foundation of subsidiaries in Oceania and Southeast Asia:

TriOS Analytics Southeast Asia and TriOS Analytics Oceania.

### TriOS

TriOS Mess- und Datentechnik GmbH has been developing and producing optical sensors for water
analysis for more than 25 years.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: TriOS is a leading manufacturer of high-quality optical measuring technology, specializing in spectral sensors designed for environmental and water monitoring applications. Their product range includes photometers, fluorometers, radiometers, and comprehensive monitoring systems, catering to diverse sectors such as environmental monitoring agencies, water treatment facilities, and marine research organizations. With a commitment to precision and innovation, TriOS provides robust solutions that enhance water quality management and support scientific research.
relevant_companies.audit_reasoning: While TriOS manufactures optical measuring technology and spectral sensors, their primary focus appears to be on environmental monitoring rather than the broader market scope that includes hyperspectral imaging and Raman spectrometers.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Agate Sensors is a pioneering company specializing in ultra-miniaturized hyperspectral intelligence, offering the world's first software-defined hyperspectral platform. Their innovative technology delivers lab-grade precision in a compact, mass-manufacturable format, enabling applications across diverse sectors such as defense, advanced imaging, and wearables. By providing programmable sensing capabilities that adapt and evolve through AI, Agate Sensors is poised to unlock new layers of insight and enhance decision-making in demanding environments.

# The World, Decoded.

Hidden information, revealed. Critical insights, delivered.
Ultra-miniaturized hyperspectral intelligence, software-defined and built to go anywhere.

## From defence and autonomous systems to the next generation of intelligent devices, Agate Sensors™
## delivers the world's first software-defined hyperspectral platform. Lab-grade, chip-scale,
## mass-manufacturable, and built to unlock entirely new layers of insight across industries.

## Engineered to bring hyperspectral intelligence from the lab to the world.

[Section3_homepage_agatesensors_update]
* REVOLUTIONARY MINIATURIZATION
  Lab-grade hyperspectral precision, previously confined to costly, complex, and bulky scientific
  instruments — now delivered on a single chip.
* SOFTWARE-DEFINED
  One chipset, many applications. Programmable sensing that adapts, evolves, and continuously learns
  — driven by AI after it ships.
* MASS-MANUFACTURABLE
  Material-agnostic and built on mainstream semiconductor processes — hyperspectral sensing designed
  for volume, cost efficiency, and scale.
* SOLID-STATE. ENGINEERED FOR DEMANDING ENVIRONMENTS
  No filters, no gratings, no moving parts — durable, compact, and built to perform where
  conventional hyperspectral systems cannot.
[ OUR TECHNOLOGY ][12]

## Beyond data. Instant understanding.

### Defence

See First. Decide First. Act First.

Detect concealed threats, read spectral signatures, and extend classification range — achieve
decisive advantage where conventional systems fall short.

[ LEARN MORE ][13]

### Imaging

What Cameras See Has Just Changed. Forever.

Capture material composition, reveal hidden information, and deliver color accuracy beyond RGB. The
imaging capability no conventional sensor can match.

[ LEARN MORE ][14]

### Wearables

Built to Read the Human Condition.

Three wavelengths were never enough. Hyperspectral sensing delivers accurate vitals, continuous
blood pressure monitoring, and new biomarker sensing in a single chip.

[ LEARN MORE ][15]

## The next frontier.

From automotive and medical to industrial and robotics, the next applications for hyperspectral
sensing are already coming into view.

[ EXPLORE THE POSSIBILITIES ][16]

relevant_companies.company_summary: Analytik Ltd. specializes in providing advanced analytical solutions and laboratory equipment for various industries, including chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food and agriculture, and environmental sectors. The company offers a comprehensive range of products, such as elemental analysis instruments, molecular spectroscopy tools, and automated sample handling systems, aimed at enhancing laboratory efficiency and accuracy in chemical analysis and life sciences applications.

liquid handling and laboratory automation technologies, Analytik Jena empowers laboratories around
the world to work quickly and successfully - from routine analysis to specialized tasks in the
fields of chemistry, pharmaceuticals, medicine and life science, food safety and agriculture, water
and wastewater analysis, environmental analysis and much more.**

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Analytik Ltd. specializes in providing advanced analytical solutions and laboratory equipment for various industries, including chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food and agriculture, and environmental sectors. The company offers a comprehensive range of products, such as elemental analysis instruments, molecular spectroscopy tools, and automated sample handling systems, aimed at enhancing laboratory efficiency and accuracy in chemical analysis and life sciences applications.
relevant_companies.audit_reasoning: While the company operates in the analytical instruments market, the specific alignment with the spectral sensor market scope is unclear, as their primary focus appears to be on molecular spectroscopy and elemental analysis rather than the full range of spectral sensors listed.
relevant_companies.key_products: Molecular Spectroscopy tools, Elemental Analysis instruments, Automated Sample Handling systems, PCR & qPCR Thermal Cyclers

_presentation_enrich.specialty_focus: Advanced analytical solutions and laboratory equipment for chemical analysis and life sciences applications

relevant_companies.company_summary: Andor Technology, part of the Oxford Instruments Group, specializes in advanced imaging and spectroscopy solutions, offering a diverse range of scientific cameras, microscopy systems, and software tailored for applications in life sciences, physical sciences, and industrial sectors. Their innovative products, including sCMOS and EMCCD cameras, as well as modular spectroscopy systems, cater to researchers and professionals seeking high-resolution and high-speed imaging capabilities across various fields such as cancer research, neuroscience, and materials science.

Applied Spectral
Imaging Solution

ASI’s comprehensive suite of computer-aided solutions for digital cytogenetics and pathology, cater to the unique demands of brightfield, fluorescence, and spectral imaging and analysis. With a steadfast focus on delivering advanced diagnostics and user-centric solutions, ASI stands at the forefront of technology in karyotyping, IHC and FISH imaging and analysis.

Who We Are

Applied Spectral Imaging (ASI) boasts a three-decade legacy of innovation in biomedical imaging, delivering cutting-edge diagnostic solutions to pathology and cytogenetic laboratories.

As a global leader with a network of distribution partners in over 80 countries, ASI values long-term, personalized customer relationships, because every diagnosis counts .

Shaping the Future of Digital Pathology and Cytogenetics

CYTOGENETICS

Explore ASI’s Digital Cytogenetics Portfolio featuring Aided Karyotyping and FISH Scanning and Analysis.

Learn more

PATHOLOGY

Discover ASI’s Digital Pathology Portfolio with Scanner-Agnostic capabilities for H&E and IHC,
and Tissue matching with FISH Specimens.

Learn more

Applied Spectral
Imaging Solution

ASI’s comprehensive suite of computer-aided solutions for digital cytogenetics and pathology, cater to the unique demands of brightfield, fluorescence, and spectral imaging and analysis. With a steadfast focus on delivering advanced diagnostics and user-centric solutions, ASI stands at the forefront of technology in karyotyping, IHC and FISH imaging and analysis.

Who We Are

Applied Spectral Imaging (ASI) boasts a three-decade legacy of innovation in biomedical imaging, delivering cutting-edge diagnostic solutions to pathology and cytogenetic laboratories.

As a global leader with a network of distribution partners in over 80 countries, ASI values long-term, personalized customer relationships, because every diagnosis counts .

Digital FISH analysis provides more efficient and accurate results and better patient care in comparison to traditional FISH methods.

Anguiano A, Wang BT, Wang SR, Boyar FZ, Mahon LW, Naggar MM, Kohn PH, Haddadin MH, Sulcova V, Sbeiti AH, Ayad MS, White BJ, Strom CM Molecular Cytogenetics

The ASI Slide Loader and Metaphase Finder runs overnight and provides a gallery of digital metaphase images ready for analysis, eliminating the time to ascertain analyzable metaphases and reducing the analysis time, ultimately increasing technologist productivity, compared to traditional methods based on microscopy.

Persaud T, Bambach R, Schmidt R, Brenholz P Journal of the Association of Genetic Technologists

As an early adopter of the PD-L1 immunostaining methodology, our group quickly recognized the inter - and intra-observer variability in scoring and interpretation of the stain, especially when there is non-uniform staining among tumor regions. We have been very pleased with the added confidence that HiPath Pro provides us in improving accuracy and precision of interpretation.

Dr. Lija Joseph Lowell General Hospital

## Products

Clyde HyperSpectral Imaging and Technology Ltd., (ClydeHSI) is a management buy-out of the business,
assets and good-will of CAMLIN Photonics Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of CAMLIN Ltd. We
specialise in optical spectroscopy and hyperspectral imaging. With over 15 years direct experience
in supplying spectral cameras and a wide range of hyperspectral systems for applications ranging
from food quality to forensics, ClydeHSI is well suited to support our customers with cost
effective, high performance instruments.

company.description: ClydeHSI specializes in optical spectroscopy and hyperspectral imaging, providing high-performance instruments for various applications including food quality and forensics.

products.name: VNIR-S
products.description: Standard central camera, suitable for many applications from colour to forensics.

products.name: VNIR-HR
products.description: High resolution spectral cameras in VNIR range.

products.name: NIR-HR
products.description: NIR range suitable for food and other applications like plastics, pharmaceuticals, art, forensics, etc.

products.name: NIR-HR+
products.description: NIR range suitable for food and other applications with high spatial resolution.

products.name: SWIR-384
products.description: SWIR range for advanced users and spectral range of samples that require longer than 1700nm.

products.name: RAMAN-532
products.description: Raman spectroscopy camera for various applications.

products.name: SC-C80 Conveyor
products.description: Integrated scanner system with speed sensors and height adjustment.
features: Can fit two cameras and run them simultaneously

products.name: Translation Stage
products.description: Stage has sample holder with white tile and focus/square pixel grid.
features: Can hold up to 2 spectral cameras

products.name: Pan and Tilt
products.description: Allows wide scene scanning with rotation capabilities.
features: Can hold and rotate up to 2 spectral cameras

products.name: Microscope
products.description: High performance microscope for detailed imaging.

products.name: SC-XYZ Large Area Series
products.description: Large area scanning systems for various applications.

products.name: spectraSENS
products.description: Comprehensive hyperspectral imaging software for use with cameras and scanning solutions.

Their product range includes advanced hyperspectral cameras and imaging systems designed for research and industry, enabling precise analysis across various fields. With a commitment to innovation, ClydeHSI empowers users to explore and measure the spectral characteristics of materials effectively.

# Investor Relations

## Corning applies its differentiated and distinctive capabilities to invent and make
## category-defining, highly engineered products, drive profitable and durable growth, and create
## long-term value

## "Springboard" Plan Priorities

[Icon]

### Capture Significant Sales Opportunity
* Internal plan
* * $20B annualized sales run rate by the end of 2026
  * $30B annualized sales run rate by the end of 2028
  * $40B annualized sales run rate by the end of 2030
* High-confidence plan
* * $27B annualized sales run rate by the end of 2028
  * $35B annualized sales run rate by the end of 2030

[Icon]

### Enhance Financial Profile
* Operating margin at or above 20%, establishing a highly profitable launch point for future growth
* Share the cost and risk of expansions with our customers to ensure strong returns and secure
  planned cash flows
* Improve ROIC into the high-teens
* Positioned to grow free cash flow while investing to capture growth

[Icon]

### Extend Leadership in our Markets
* Probability of success increases as we deliver key milestones and advance strategic initiatives
* Significant secular trends require Corning's leadership capabilities, supporting sustainable
  long-term growth
* "More Corning" content opportunities from innovation with customers enhance their products and
  increase Corning value capture

[Icon]

### Reward Shareholders
* Invest in organic growth opportunities to support long-term growth and drive significant returns
* Incremental cash flow supports dividends and continued share buybacks

## Foundation of Long-Term Success

### Strong Financial Discipline

Corning’s priorities for capital allocation are to invest in profitable organic growth, extend
leadership in distinctive capabilities, and reward shareholders. Return on invested capital
increases through the reuse and repurposing of assets, secure customer commitments and high ROIC
projects.

[Learn More][61]

### Consistent Stakeholder Commitment

The company maintains positive, symbiotic relationships with its people, partners, communities,
investors, society including future stakeholders. Corning is deeply committed to its own
sustainability journey and to inventions that help the world advance sustainability. Our history of
impact speaks for itself.

The company offers a wide range of products including optical lenses, filters, mirrors, and prisms, catering to diverse industries such as imaging, laser technology, and scientific research. With a commitment to quality and innovation, Edmund Optics serves engineers and researchers globally, providing expert guidance and support for their optical needs.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Figspec is a leading manufacturer of hyperspectral imaging technology, specializing in a diverse range of products including portable hyperspectral cameras, aerial imaging systems, and multispectral cameras. The company serves various industries such as agriculture, food safety, and industrial inspection, providing advanced solutions for non-destructive testing and analysis through innovative spectral imaging techniques. With a commitment to quality and cutting-edge technology, Figspec aims to enhance the capabilities of its clients in observing and analyzing the world through spectral data.

Hyperspectral Imaging

## DHYNAMite

## Integrativer Pflanzenschutz durch Drohnen-basierte hyperspektrale Identifizierung von
## Spinnmilbenbefallsherden und bedarfsgerechte Nützlingsapplikation im Freilandgurkenanbau

## Integrated plant protection through drone-based hyperspectral identification of spider mite
## infestation hotspots and demand-driven beneficial organism application in outdoor cucumber
## cultivation

In our latest research project, HAIP Solutions collaborates with Katz Biotech, Weber Agrar Robotik
GmbH and the Institute of Botany at Leibniz University Hannover to advance integrative and
sustainable plant protection. The joint goal is to enable a demand-oriented and precise application
of beneficial organisms as a biological alternative to chemical pesticides. By using hyperspectral
imaging (HSI), pest infestation can be monitored automatically, infestation hotspots can be
identified early, and treatment success can be evaluated over time.

The project focuses specifically on detecting spider mite infestation in open-field cucumber
cultivation. To ensure reliable forecasting models and infestation monitoring, consistent
illumination conditions during data acquisition are essential. This makes atmospheric correction a
central requirement when deploying hyperspectral imaging in the field.

# Research Projects

Hyperspectral Imaging

## DHYNAMite

## Integrativer Pflanzenschutz durch Drohnen-basierte hyperspektrale Identifizierung von
## Spinnmilbenbefallsherden und bedarfsgerechte Nützlingsapplikation im Freilandgurkenanbau

## Integrated plant protection through drone-based hyperspectral identification of spider mite
## infestation hotspots and demand-driven beneficial organism application in outdoor cucumber
## cultivation

In our latest research project, HAIP Solutions collaborates with Katz Biotech, Weber Agrar Robotik
GmbH and the Institute of Botany at Leibniz University Hannover to advance integrative and
sustainable plant protection. The joint goal is to enable a demand-oriented and precise application
of beneficial organisms as a biological alternative to chemical pesticides. By using hyperspectral
imaging (HSI), pest infestation can be monitored automatically, infestation hotspots can be
identified early, and treatment success can be evaluated over time.

The project focuses specifically on detecting spider mite infestation in open-field cucumber
cultivation. To ensure reliable forecasting models and infestation monitoring, consistent
illumination conditions during data acquisition are essential. This makes atmospheric correction a
central requirement when deploying hyperspectral imaging in the field.

By combining biological expertise with advanced sensing technologies, the project aims to reduce
chemical pesticide use by at least 50%. The precision deployment of beneficial organisms such as
predatory mites provides an ecological, highly specific, and sustainable plant protection strategy
aligned with the German National Bioeconomy Strategy.

## Key Facts
* **Project duration**: 08/2025 – 07/2028
* **Funding measure**: BMFTR – Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt
* **Leading project management organization**: Projektträger Jülich (PtJ)
* **Project partners**: Katz Biotech AG (KBAG), Weber Agrar Robotik GmbH – WEBARO (WAR), Leibniz
Universität – Institut für Botanik (LUH), HAIP Solutions GmbH

# Research Projects

Hyperspectral Imaging

## EMSig

## Entwicklung einer hyperspektralen Messplattform zur Schadsymptomerkennung im geschützten
## Tomatenanbau

## Development of a hyperspectral measurement platform for pest symptom detection in protected
## tomato cultivation

The subject of the joint project is the development of a hyperspectral measurement platform for
fully autonomous pest symptom detection of the most important pests, diseases and stress symptoms in
protected tomato cultivation. The directly evaluated probability of infestation of various harmful
organisms is to be made available to the user in a user-friendly interface in the form of an app.
The innovation of the technology lies in the combination of a self-propelled platform already
established on the market with the hyperspectral measurement module to be developed, including the
implementation of corresponding algorithms.

The aim of the joint project is a minimum viable product (MVP) for practical use in soilless
greenhouses. With the help of the envisaged system, the previously manual monitoring should be
decoupled from the actual work processes and the grower should receive early warnings when a pest
symptom occurs. In this way, the project contributes to a more targeted use of personnel and reduced
use of plant protection.

[Research project Emsig by HAIP Solutions]

* **Project duration**: 01/2024 – 12/2026
* **Funding measure**: Program for the promotion of innovation of the BMEL
* **Project partners**: Julius Kühn Institute Federal Research Institute for Cultivated Plants
(JKI), Wolution GmbH & Co. KG, HAIP Solutions GmbH

## DeteKTiL

## Detektion von Kunststoff-Teilchen in der Lebensmittelproduktion

## Detection of plastic particles in food production

The aim of the KMU innovation project DeteKTiL is the developement of a detection system that is
able to recognize transparent plastic parts via their chemical structure in the infrared range. For
this purpose, a conveyor belt system is being designed that ensures an optimally illuminated 360°
scan of the food in the process and thus simultaneously enables the detection of the
chemical-physical structure of foreign particles by means of a spectral camera and thus ensures
their automatic ejection.

The overriding added value of this project is the reduction in the number of product recalls. This
results in a lower health risk for consumers (no ingestion of plastic particles), an economic
advantage for companies and CO2 savings due to less faulty production, destruction of food with
foreign bodies and less logistical effort.

## Key Facts
* **Project duration**: 01/2024 – 12/2025
* **Funding measure**: KMU innovativ – Production Research in the program “Future of Value Creation”
of the BMBF
* **Project partners**: CLK GmbH – Bildverarbeitung & Robotik, Singer & Sohn GmbH – Förderanlagen-
und Maschinenbau, Technische Hochschule Nürnberg Georg Simon Ohm (THN), HAIP Solutions GmbH

## Mikroplastikanalyse (IKK)

## ZIM Durchführbarkeitsstudie: Einsatz hyperspektraler Bildgebung zur Mikroplastikanalyse

## ZIM feasibility study: Use of hyperspectral imaging for microplastic analysis

The release of plastics into the environment is a major global problem, with microplastics posing a
growing threat to ecosystems. Current analytical methods, such as FTIR and Raman microscopy, are
expensive and complex, limiting large-scale monitoring.

The planned ZIM feasibility study aims to develop a more accessible hyperspectral imaging based
system that will enable a more efficient and widespread analysis of microplastics to support efforts
to reduce pollution. The main objectives are to ensure low susceptibility to failure and a high
degree of automation in the analysis process. A key component of the project is the creation of a
classification database capable of identifying a wide range of plastic types. In addition,
integrated particle analysis will be developed to determine the size and shape of microplastic
particles.

To achieve a competitive product, the system will be designed to detect microplastic particles as
small as 100 μm, complete measurements in less than

[HAIP Solutions Research Project Mikroplastikanalyse IKK]

10 minutes and identify at least the following six polymer types: PP, PE, PET, PS, PVC and PU.
Evaluation capabilities include polymer type identification with spectral matching, particle
counting and particle size and shape measurements.

For the first time, a third-generation hyperspectral camera will be used for the analysis of
microplastics. The system is significantly less expensive and easier to use than established
methods, while making it accessible to new user groups and mobile applications.

## Key Facts
* **Project duration**: 10/2024 – 05/2025
* **Funding measure**: Funding program of the Federal Ministry of Economics and Climate Protection
“Central Innovation Program for SMEs” (ZIM), funding module feasibility studies
* **Project partners**: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Universität, Institut für Kunststoff- und
Kreislauftechnik, HAIP Solutions

# Research Projects

Hyperspectral Imaging

## PWGram

## Experimentelle Forschung zur Entwicklung eines Multisensor-Messsystems mit Marktreife zur
## berührungslosen Bestimmung des Wasserversorgungszustands mittels Nahbereichsphotogrammetrie

## Experimental research on the development of a multi-sensor measuring system with market maturity
## for the non-contact determination of water supply status using short-range photogrammetry

The aim of the joint project is to further develop the PLANTSENS multi-sensor measuring system for
determining the water supply status of plants into a marketable pre-series model. The measuring
system will be tested indoors, outdoors and in combination with various carrier systems (rail,
drone, vehicle, watering trolley, stationary) on various crops in order to create documentation for
use and application. Furthermore, the design of an optimized housing with a fastening system that is
compatible with the various carrier systems is being developed. The innovation lies in the further
technical development of the multi-sensor measuring system in order to record the water supply
status of plants without the need for soil measurements.

## Key Facts
* **Project duration**: 08/2024 – 07/2027
* **Funding measure**: Program to promote innovation of the Federal Ministry of Food and Agriculture
German Innovation Partnership Agriculture (DIP)
* **Project partners**: Berliner Hochschule für Technik, rabo R. Bormann und Sohn, HAIP Solutions
GmbH

## HyperFoil

## Hyperspektralkamera unterstützt selektive Laser-Entlackung von hinterleuchteten Folienträgern

## Hyperspectral camera-assisted selective laser ablation from blacklit film carriers

##### **HyperFoil: Hyperspectral imaging for automated laser ablation of coated foils**

HAIP Solutions is redefining quality assurance in laser processing of coated foils. As part of the
HyperFoil research project, we are developing an innovative approach that combines hyperspectral
imaging (HSI) with automated laser ablation by enabling precise material removal, real-time process
control, and greater design freedom in industrial manufacturing.

##### **The Challenge: Inconsistent coatings and unreliable results**

Decorative and functional foils are used across industries like automotive, electronics, and
furniture manufacturing, because these films serve both aesthetic and functional purposes. However,
as design demands increase for finer structural details, sharper contours and greater customisation.

Traditional laser ablation often struggles to deliver consistent results, because local variations
in coating composition can lead to problems like uneven material removal or substrate damage,
negatively impacting product quality, production speed, and process reliability.

##### **The Solution: Spectral sensing meets intelligent laser control**

In HyperFoil, a joint project with Fraunhofer IFAM, SiTec, Manikewicz, and HAIP Solutions, we are
developing a technology demonstrator for inline-capable, quality-assured laser ablation. At the core
of this innovation is HAIP’s hyperspectral imaging technology, enabling real-time, pixel-precise
coating analysis.

Key benefits of the solution:
* Real-time detection of coating thickness and material variations
* AI-powered laser parameter adjustment for selective layer removal
* On-camera machine learning for classification and anomaly detection
* Custom illumination systems for consistent, high-fidelity imaging

Key areas of expertise of the partners

##### **HAIP Solutions technology **

As a technology leader in hyperspectral imaging for industrial applications, HAIP Solutions
provides:
* BlackIndustry cameras with pushbroom technology for high-resolution SWIR imaging
* Edge processing capabilities with real-time machine learning directly on the sensor
* Integrated illumination systems designed for laser ablation environments
* A robust platform for fully automated process optimisation and quality assurance

**The result:** A formerly manual, lab-based process becomes an automated, inline-capable solution
for advanced manufacturing.

Left: Unregulated laser ablation using an IR laser. Center and right: Prototype HSI camera used by a
robot to scan surfaces so that grid cuts can be analysed. © Fraunhofer IFAM

##### **Shaping the future of industrial laser processing**

HyperFoil demonstrates how photonics, AI, and spectral sensing can converge to unlock new
possibilities in surface processing. This approach offers maximum precision and
repeatability, educed scrap and process downtime, and greater design flexibility for coated foils
and complex surfaces. By integrating hyperspectral imaging into laser ablation workflows, HAIP
Solutions is setting new standards in industrial quality assurance and digital manufacturing.

## KI gestützte, spektroskopische Ermittlung der Alterung von Kunststoffen beim mechanischen
## Recycling

## AI-supported, spectroscopic determination of the ageing of plastics during mechanical recycling

The increasing use of plastics requires a sustainable circular economy, i.e. the cyclical reuse of
plastics after the end-of-life of products.

The associated challenges in waste management require innovative solutions. The SpectralAIge joint
project aims to develop the world’s first spectroscopic measurement systems that can assess the
process-related material ageing of plastics quickly and precisely. With the support of artificial
intelligence (AI), the best possible decisions are to be made for the processing and use of
secondary plastics in order to recognize and sort plastic material that has aged to varying degrees
and to feed it into the optimal recycling path.

The knowledge gained from the project should make it possible to identify degraded materials in the
closed PET deposit bottle cycle and in plastic sorting systems. This offers the option of making the
best possible decisions for the processing and use of secondary plastics. Sorting out excessively
degraded materials at an early stage ensures a higher quality of recyclate. This is essential, for
example in the production of food packaging such as returnable bottles.

[HAIP Solutions Joint research project SpectralAIge]

**Challenges due to material ageing**

Plastics are repeatedly exposed to high temperatures and mechanical stresses during the recycling
process, usually in the extrusion and injection molding process. This can lead to ageing or
degradation of the materials. If the concentration of heavily aged material in the manufacturing
process is too high, the quality of the product could deteriorate. This can lead to the product no
longer being allowed to be placed on the market due to quality defects. Although additives can
compensate for these ageing processes to a certain extent, the only option for heavily aged material
is downcycling or chemical recycling. However, there is currently a lack of industrial processes for
quickly and reliably analyzing and evaluating the ageing of plastic waste.

**Research project pursues two possible approaches**
In the first project approach, hyperspectral camera systems (HSI), which are already established in
plastics sorting, will be expanded to include LED-based light sources for fluorescence excitation.
In addition to the classic absorption spectra, excited fluorescence spectra can also be recorded.
The analysis of this spectral data using AI enables the precise determination of the material ageing
of plastic waste.

The second approach focuses on the development of AI-supported, inexpensive inverted spectrometers.
To this end, relevant wavelengths are extracted from broadband measurement results from HSI
measurements and an inverse spectrometer is built using this data. This should allow conclusions to
be drawn about the process-related ageing of plastic materials. In contrast to a spectrometer, which
covers a complete wavelength range, an inverse spectrometer only covers specific individual
wavelength bands. This allows production costs to be reduced and a wide range of industrial
applications to be achieved.

**Great economic potential**
“The knowledge gained from the research project can be used to promote a wide range of economic
applications and enable SMEs to move towards a circular economy through the optimal use of secondary
plastics,” says Frank Stüpmann, Managing Director of Silicann Systems GmbH.

“We hope that the packaging sector, among others, will benefit greatly from the developments in the
project. This generates the largest proportion of post-consumer (PC) plastic waste and there are
short product life cycles and consequently frequent processing,” adds Dr. Linda Mittelberg, Head of
Quality and Life Cycle at SKZ. “The results can be used in PET deposit bottle cycles and plastic
sorting plants in particular.”

## We are
## HAIP Solutions

## Since 2018, HAIP Solutions GmbH, a young tech company from Hanover (Germany), has been working in
## the development of user-oriented hyperspectral imaging (HSI) camera solutions. Our products based
## on spectral technology are used in the fields of plant breeding, agriculture and forestry, food
## industry, recycling and geology. We strongly believe that spectral imaging can contribute to
## making the world a more sustainable planet. We want to make it as easy and intuitive as possible
## for the users of our products to be able to enjoy and use hyperspectral technology. Since the
## start of our company, we have been working intensively with partners from various fields to put
## the user at the centre of our solutions.

HAIP Solutions

Since 2018, HAIP Solutions GmbH, a young tech company from Hanover (Germany), has been working in
the development of user-oriented hyperspectral imaging (HSI) camera solutions.
Our products based on spectral technology are used in the fields of plant breeding, agriculture and
forestry, food industry, recycling and geology. We strongly believe that spectral imaging can
contribute to making the world a more sustainable planet.

We want to make it as easy and intuitive as possible for the users of our products to be able to
enjoy and use hyperspectral technology. Since the start of our company, we have been working
intensively with partners from various fields to put the user at the centre of our solutions.

# Team

HAIP Solutions

## We are
## HAIP Solutions

## Since 2018, HAIP Solutions GmbH, a young tech company from Hanover (Germany), has been working in
## the development of user-oriented hyperspectral imaging (HSI) camera solutions. Our products based
## on spectral technology are used in the fields of plant breeding, agriculture and forestry, food
## industry, recycling and geology. We strongly believe that spectral imaging can contribute to
## making the world a more sustainable planet. We want to make it as easy and intuitive as possible
## for the users of our products to be able to enjoy and use hyperspectral technology. Since the
## start of our company, we have been working intensively with partners from various fields to put
## the user at the centre of our solutions.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Headwall Photonics is a leader in applied sensing and hyperspectral imaging, delivering innovative solutions that enhance environmental protection, food supply chain integrity, and quality control in pharmaceuticals and manufacturing. The company offers a range of products, including industrial inspection systems, metal detection sensors, and hyperspectral imaging cameras, targeting diverse sectors such as agriculture, recycling, defense, and pharmaceuticals. By transforming invisible data into actionable insights, Headwall empowers organizations to improve operational efficiency and ensure safety across various industries.

Every Pixel Has a Purpose

From in-line inspection to airborne monitoring, Headwall turns invisible data into actionable insight—empowering smarter decisions across science and industry.

Talk To an Expert

This is Applied Sensing

Turning molecular data into measurable impact.

Shining light on what remains unseen.

At the molecular level, matter holds its truth.

Where matter meets light, clarity begins.

Headwall combines spectral imaging, precision optics, and software intelligence to make the unseen measurable.

Leveraging hyperspectral cameras and advanced imaging technologies, our solutions strengthen supply chains, protect natural resources, and advance quality and safety across critical industries.

Trusted worldwide, Headwall delivers reliable, real-world sensing systems that turn spectral data into actionable insight—from the lab to the line, from Earth to orbit.

Learn more about how hyperspectral imaging works

Usability— not complexity —
drives results.

Performance isn't defined by the longest spec sheet.

It's defined by how reliably you can turn data into decisions.

The advantage of partnering with Headwall is our commitment to make applied sensing more accessible, integrated, and impactful across the systems that sustain life and drive progress.

Every Headwall system, every integration, every deployment is built around that principle—removing unnecessary complexity and engineering for what truly delivers value: clarity, consistency, and confidence in every measurement.

Proven Performance.
Trusted by Design.

Every Headwall applied sensing platform bridges laboratory precision and operational reality —capturing calibrated spectral data from the air, in the field, in the lab, and on the production line.

Built for OEM and production environments with interoperable hardware and software interfaces, open SDKs, and documented APIs for seamless deployment.

Spectral Data Continuity

Connects every stage of spectral intelligence—from data capture to decision—for consistent, comparable insight across platforms.

Factory-aligned, thermally stable, and field-proven to maintain calibration under demanding conditions.

Usability

Designed for intuitive operation and efficient data flow that simplify complex measurements.

Range and Precision

Delivers full UV–SWIR coverage with uniform accuracy across every wavelength and configuration.

Credibility

Backed by two decades of optical innovation and trusted worldwide by leading OEMs and research partners.

# About Us

## Taking on the toughest problems in science and industry.

For more than two decades, Headwall has earned trust as a leader in applied sensing and
hyperspectral imaging. Proven at speed and scale, Headwall solutions help protect the
[environment][46], strengthen food supply chains from [harvest][47] to [distribution][48], improve
[recycling and materials recovery][49], ensure [pharmaceutical][50] and [manufacturing quality
control][51], and enhance [defense and security][52] operations.

But this is only the beginning. Every day, researchers, engineers, and manufacturers find new ways
to apply Headwall solutions—from [portable hyperspectral field instruments][53] and ready-to-use
[hyperspectral benchtop labs][54] that accelerate discovery to full-scale [hyperspectral imaging
camera systems][55] on the line. Headwall supports today’s most pressing challenges while enabling
tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

## Applied Sensing: From Ground to Orbit

### Headwall delivers the clarity that drives innovation at scale—enabling quantitative spectral
### insight across environmental systems, mission-critical assets, and industrial automation.

This is applied sensing: capturing and interpreting data invisible to the human eye, then turning it
into actionable insight. It reveals what materials are made of, detects change as it happens, and
gives decision-makers the confidence to act.

## Headwall sensing solutions are found wherever composition and quality matter.

Worldwide—from [smart manufacturing][56] and [recycling recovery][57] to research, remote sensing,
and [airborne][58] missions—Headwall sensing systems create an ecosystem of insight—closing the loop
between production, environment, and progress.

Headwall applied sensing unites research, industry, and environment—creating a continuous data
continuum from ground truth to orbit that drives measurable progress for our planet and its
industries.

## How Headwall Works

Headwall transforms invisible data into actionable insight that sustains life, safeguards
communities, and advances human progress.

The name “Headwall” comes from Mount Washington’s Tuckerman Ravine, where a steep, unforgiving climb
inspired a company culture. Here, challenges are not barriers but opportunities. A headwall is the
most difficult part of a mountain face: a point where skill, perseverance, and teamwork matter most.
At Headwall, challenges are not barriers but opportunities to ascend.

[Meet the Leadership Team →][59]

## The Future of Hyperspectral Imaging

Headwall reveals the full potential of applied hyperspectral imaging. Proven today in [food][60],
[water][61], materials, [infrastructure][62], and [security][63], sensing technologies continue to
open new frontiers. Today, industries are scaling validated solutions from pilot projects to global
operations, while researchers continue to push the boundaries with spectral analysis tools that
accelerate discovery.

The future of Headwall lies in enabling these breakthroughs—making applied sensing more accessible,
more integrated, and more impactful across the systems that sustain life and drive progress. Like
the climb that inspired its name, each new challenge represents an opportunity to ascend, and with
it, we reach higher, together.

## Headwall and Arsenal Capital Partners

Headwall is part of the Arsenal Capital Partners portfolio, a leading private equity firm focused on
industrial growth. With Arsenal’s support, Headwall accelerates the development of new technologies
and brings scalable solutions to market.

Chief Marketing Officer

As Chief Marketing Officer, Elizabeth is responsible for aligning portfolio messaging, go-to-market
execution, and customer engagement across products, regions, and teams. She works closely with
product, sales, and leadership to ensure Headwall’s capabilities are clearly articulated,
differentiated, and connected to real customer outcomes—supporting growth across both industrial

integration, and market evolution. Her background includes translating complex, systems-based

# Jim Gareau

Chief Commercial Officer

As Chief Commercial Officer, Jim oversees Headwall’s global go-to-market strategy, aligning
commercial efforts to support OEM integrators and deliver long-term value for customers worldwide.
His leadership emphasizes market expansion, customer collaboration, and competitive differentiation
across Headwall’s industrial and remote sensing markets.

Jim brings more than 20 years of commercial leadership in precision technologies, with experience
spanning the life sciences, defense, semiconductor, and imaging sectors. Before joining Headwall, he
served as Vice President and Business Line Leader at IDEX Health & Science, focused on
super-resolution imaging for life science instrumentation. He also held senior leadership roles at
SCHOTT, Physik Instrumente, and Aperture Optical Sciences, where he guided teams through growth,
customer expansion, and global commercial execution.

Jim holds an MBA from Northeastern University’s D’Amore-McKim School of Business and a BS in
Mechanical Engineering from the University of Connecticut. His combined technical and commercial
background enables him to bridge engineering and market needs—supporting customers with solutions
that scale and differentiate.

Chief Operating Officer

# Hunter Isakson

Chief Financial Officer

As Chief Financial Officer, Hunter provides the financial leadership and strategic oversight that
enable Headwall to grow with discipline and confidence.
He ensures the company maintains the fiscal strength, clarity, and governance needed to support
long-term success across global markets.

Hunter brings more than 20 years of financial leadership across global technology and manufacturing
organizations, including senior roles at Ernst & Young and KPMG, followed by Director, Controller,
and CFO positions in multinational enterprises. Before joining Headwall, he served as CFO for Raptor
Scientific, a global provider of measurement and testing solutions for the aerospace and defense
industries.

He earned both Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in Accounting from Wake Forest University and is a
licensed CPA known for driving profitability and long-term financial performance.

# Tim Spang

Chief Executive Officer

As Chief Executive Officer, Tim is responsible for setting direction, aligning the organization, and
ensuring Headwall delivers consistent value for OEM integrators, industrial partners, and research
customers worldwide. His leadership emphasizes disciplined execution, operational clarity, and a
seamless customer experience across the company’s global footprint.

Tim brings more than 30 years of leadership in advanced manufacturing, robotics, automation, and
medical technology. Before joining Headwall, he held senior roles at Bayer, Haemonetics, Seegrid,
Diligent Robotics, Unilife Medical, and Ariba, where he led teams through periods of growth,
operational evolution, and technology-driven transformation.

Tim holds an MBA from Carnegie Mellon University’s Tepper School of Business and a BS in Industrial
Engineering from Penn State University. He also completed advanced German studies at the
Goethe-Institut in Munich.

# About Us

## Taking on the toughest problems in science and industry.

For more than two decades, Headwall has earned trust as a leader in applied sensing and
hyperspectral imaging. Proven at speed and scale, Headwall solutions help protect the
[environment][46], strengthen food supply chains from [harvest][47] to [distribution][48], improve
[recycling and materials recovery][49], ensure [pharmaceutical][50] and [manufacturing quality
control][51], and enhance [defense and security][52] operations.

But this is only the beginning. Every day, researchers, engineers, and manufacturers find new ways
to apply Headwall solutions—from [portable hyperspectral field instruments][53] and ready-to-use
[hyperspectral benchtop labs][54] that accelerate discovery to full-scale [hyperspectral imaging
camera systems][55] on the line. Headwall supports today’s most pressing challenges while enabling
tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

## Applied Sensing: From Ground to Orbit

### Headwall delivers the clarity that drives innovation at scale—enabling quantitative spectral
### insight across environmental systems, mission-critical assets, and industrial automation.

This is applied sensing: capturing and interpreting data invisible to the human eye, then turning it
into actionable insight. It reveals what materials are made of, detects change as it happens, and
gives decision-makers the confidence to act.

## Headwall sensing solutions are found wherever composition and quality matter.

Worldwide—from [smart manufacturing][56] and [recycling recovery][57] to research, remote sensing,
and [airborne][58] missions—Headwall sensing systems create an ecosystem of insight—closing the loop
between production, environment, and progress.

Headwall applied sensing unites research, industry, and environment—creating a continuous data
continuum from ground truth to orbit that drives measurable progress for our planet and its
industries.

## How Headwall Works

Headwall transforms invisible data into actionable insight that sustains life, safeguards
communities, and advances human progress.

The name “Headwall” comes from Mount Washington’s Tuckerman Ravine, where a steep, unforgiving climb
inspired a company culture. Here, challenges are not barriers but opportunities. A headwall is the
most difficult part of a mountain face: a point where skill, perseverance, and teamwork matter most.
At Headwall, challenges are not barriers but opportunities to ascend.

[Meet the Leadership Team →][59]

## The Future of Hyperspectral Imaging

Headwall reveals the full potential of applied hyperspectral imaging. Proven today in [food][60],
[water][61], materials, [infrastructure][62], and [security][63], sensing technologies continue to
open new frontiers. Today, industries are scaling validated solutions from pilot projects to global
operations, while researchers continue to push the boundaries with spectral analysis tools that
accelerate discovery.

The future of Headwall lies in enabling these breakthroughs—making applied sensing more accessible,
more integrated, and more impactful across the systems that sustain life and drive progress. Like
the climb that inspired its name, each new challenge represents an opportunity to ascend, and with
it, we reach higher, together.

## Headwall and Arsenal Capital Partners

Headwall is part of the Arsenal Capital Partners portfolio, a leading private equity firm focused on
industrial growth. With Arsenal’s support, Headwall accelerates the development of new technologies
and brings scalable solutions to market.

## COMPANY

## Introducing Company

[ci_logo.png]

## Beyond Human Visibility

## in Automation Machinery Manufacturing

About Hypergram Inc.

Hypergram Inc. aims to revolutionize the automated machinery manufacturing industry with
cutting-edge hyperspectral imaging technology capable of detecting defects invisible to the human
eye and conventional machine vision cameras. Founded in 2023 by Dr. Min H. Kim [[link][26]] as a
KAIST faculty startup in Korea, Hypergram is dedicated to building autonomous inspection systems
that surpass human visual capabilities, particularly in the field of automated machinery
manufacturing.

Our team comprises leading experts in computational imaging, physics, photography, machine learning,
artificial intelligence, and computer science, including professors and Ph.D. graduates from KAIST.
Leveraging this diverse expertise, Hypergram is pioneering the future of machine vision inspection
technology — faster, more reliable, more precise, and more efficient — by overcoming the inherent
limitations of human vision and conventional camera systems.

With over 15 years of accumulated experience, knowledge, and passion in advanced imaging
technologies, Hypergram is committed to leading technological advancements in the machine vision
industry. Our vision is to capture the highest-precision hyperspectral images at the fastest
possible speeds without compromising between speed and accuracy. Step by step, we are bringing
cutting-edge hyperspectral imaging solutions to life.

Hypergram provides state-of-the-art hyperspectral cameras and machine vision AI software solutions
tailored for the automated machinery manufacturing sector.

Thank you.

Min H. Kim

[ceo_500_580.jpg]

###### CEO

### Dr. Min H. Kim

## Hyperspectral Camera & AI Software Solution

## HYPERGRAM

Hypergram Inc. provides a combined solution that consists of industry-level hyperspectral video
camera hardware and advanced spectral image analysis software. The name of our company is derived
from combining these two words: hyper- from hyperspectral camera and -gram from machine vision AI
program. Our unified solution can speed up the existing hyperspectral imaging solution and make it
work more accurately in detecting and classifying target objects through the automation machinery
manufacturing pipeline. Our machine vision solution will improve non-destructive and automated
inspection in the manufacturing, food, recycling, and biomedical industries. Our team is dedicated
to revolutionizing the way businesses conduct quality control and inspection processes. With
cutting-edge technology and a passion for innovation, we aim to set new standards in the machine
vision industry.

## CI Concept

[ci_symbol.png]

Our company’s logo symbolizes the energy of light refracted through a prism, depicting the
transition from short to long wavelengths. The fusion of two prisms, spiraling together, represents
the integration of innovative technologies: hyperspectral imaging and AI software solution in the
automation machinery manufactoring while also forming the initial "H" of Hypergram. This logo
embodies our vision of "Beyond Human Visibility," presenting new possibilities that go beyond the
limits of human sight in industrial machine vision applications.

### Our Vision

## Accelerate Humanity’s
## Expansion Into Space

Our hyperspectral satellite constellation will monitor the planet in detail and map resource-rich
zones across the solar system, paving the way for asteroidal discovery. In time, this will enable
heavy industry to shift off-planet, easing Earth’s burden and opening new frontiers.

We see a future where space technology drives global progress, empowers environmental solutions, and
makes interplanetary life possible.
