# What drives us

As the pioneer of science in optics, we continue to challenge the limits of human imagination.

## Shaping the future

ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the optics and
optoelectronics industries. As a company wholly owned by a foundation, ZEISS is rooted in and
committed to responsibility in all its activities. As the pioneer of scientific optics, we continue
to challenge the limits of human imagination. With our passion for excellence we create value for
our customers and inspire the world to see in new ways.

## Innovative solutions

The semiconductor industry, e-mobility providers, Nobel Prize winners, medical clinics and
ophthalmologists, film makers and eye care practitioners – to name but a few – rely on ZEISS.
Its optics are needed to manufacture microchips, research infectious diseases, manage the quality of
electric cars and windmills, provide the best possible treatment for brain and eye surgery or create
award-winning films.
* [ Products & Solutions ][15]

## A strong foundation

The company was founded in 1846 by Carl Zeiss, who anchored precision, a commitment to innovation
and the creation of real value for customers and society. In 1889, Ernst Abbe established the Carl
Zeiss Foundation in memory of his partner as the sole owner of ZEISS, until today the foundation is
exclusively committed to promoting science and progress. As a pioneer of corporate responsibility
ZEISS is following a clear path: To enable customers to achieve their goals with value-added
solutions developed and manufactured in a responsible manner.
* [ Carl Zeiss Foundation ][16]

## Committed to sustainability

The foundation as owner is expecting sustainable contributions from ZEISS. The company's dividends
are used by the foundation to fund scientific and research programs in areas essential to the future
of humanity, from the aging society to the circular economy. ZEISS works toward clear goals: By
fiscal year 2024/25, the company aims to reduce scope 1 and 2 emissions as much as possible and to
offset the remaining unavoidable emissions. Specific programs for MINT education, public health
care, nature and climate protection and social commitment are part of the global ZEISS
sustainability strategy.
* [ Sustainability at ZEISS ][17]

## A future-oriented portfolio

Today, around 46,600 employees globally in around 50 countries work hard to fulfill and exceed
customer expectations. They generated total annual revenue of nearly 12 billion euros (fiscal year
2024/25) in the four ZEISS segments Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Quality &
Research, Medical Technology and Consumer Markets. Currently, 15 percent of revenue is invested in
science and R&D. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future
and solutions for global challenges.
* [ Innovation at ZEISS ][18]

## Find out more about ZEISS

Check out our innovative solutions, our company by the numbers and dive into the world of ZEISS.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: HORIBA is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of scientific and analytical instruments, specializing in a diverse range of applications across mobility, energy, environment, life sciences, and healthcare sectors. The company offers innovative solutions such as gas mass flow control, hydrogen energy evaluation, and advanced elemental analysis technologies, catering to industries including automotive, pharmaceuticals, and environmental management. With a commitment to enhancing efficiency and sustainability, HORIBA serves a wide array of markets, including research institutions, industrial processes, and energy solutions.

## Insights & News


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][244]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.


###### [Project Farma Partners with Valkit.ai to Modernize Digital Validation with AI][245]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced its Gold Tier Certified Partner status
with Valkit.ai, an AI-powered digital validation platform that streamlines compliance and quality
processes for life sciences organizations.


###### [LactoScope 500 Delivers Next-Level Dairy Analysis, for Greater Accuracy, Stability, and
###### Operational Control][246]

Perten, a PerkinElmer company and global leader in analytical solutions for the food industry, today
announced the launch of the LactoScope 500, a next-generation Fourier Transform Infrared
Spectroscopy (FT‑IR) dairy analyzer designed to help medium and large processors move beyond
traditional testing limitations for greater control of quality, yield, and efficiency.


###### [PacBio and Covaris Announce Joint Workflow Enabling HiFi Sequencing of FFPE Tumor
###### Samples][247]

PacBio (NASDAQ: PACB), a leading developer of high-quality, highly accurate sequencing solutions,
and Covaris, a PerkinElmer company and leader in sample preparation technologies, today announced a
joint workflow enabling robust HiFi sequencing of formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue
samples. This new solution integrates Covaris’ truXTRAC^{®} FFPE extraction technology with PacBio’s
Kinnex™ library preparation, delivering a streamlined workflow from sample to sequencing.

link. Obviously, behind such activities there are **criminals who try to gain trust from possible
victims by pretending that their mails are from RP Photonics, a reputable source**. Some of them are

**Please do *not* put our addresses or our domain on any e-mail blacklist.** Indeed, you should be
safe putting them on any e-mail whitelist, assuming that your mail server properly does the usual
tests.

# Dr. Rüdiger Paschotta, Founder and Managing Director of RP Photonics AG

[Picture of Dr. Rüdiger Paschotta]

Dr. Rüdiger Paschotta has an international reputation as a highly distinguished expert in technical
areas such as lasers and amplifiers, nonlinear optics, fiber technology, ultrashort pulses, and
noise in optics. He is author or coauthor of many [publications][15], in particular of over 100
articles in scientific journals, over 120 presentations at international conferences, and of several
books and book chapters. Also, he is the author of the well-known [RP Photonics Encyclopedia][16],
an extremely popular authoritative resource.

Dr. Paschotta originally started his career in scientific research. In 2002, he achieved the
habilitation at ETH Zürich and received the [Fresnel Prize of the European Physical Society
(EPS)][17] in 2002. Despite his success as a researcher (see his [CV with publication list][18]), in
2004 he started the company RP Photonics Consulting GmbH in Zürich, Switzerland. (The company moved
to Bad Dürrheim, Germany, in 2010, and [to Frauenfeld, Switzerland, in 2022][19], and is now RP
Photonics AG.) He [serves][20] companies in the photonics industry worldwide. Typical tasks are to
work out feasibility studies and designs for lasers and other photonic devices, to identify and
solve technical problems, to find suitable laser sources for specific applications, and to do
[tailored staff training courses][21] on specialized subjects. Dr. Paschotta regularly achieves very
high levels of customer satisfaction.

He is also a thought leader and influencer in photonics. For example:
* He is a strong advocate of [simulation in photonics][22] as a powerful method for understanding
technology and achieving improvements — not only with higher quality results, but also with higher
efficiency.
* He warmly recommends investing more in education, the key for future success. He very actively
contributes to photonics education worldwide — in particular, with his open-access [RP Photonics
Encyclopedia][23], but also with [tailored training courses][24].
* He firmly stands for reliable truth and for scientific methods as the best way to establish it. In
particular, government actions should always be based on evidence rather than ideology. Science
and engineering people should firmly stand up against attacks on science and reason.
* He is fully aware that cooperation is key for success. That must include international cooperation
in many fields, such as science, climate crisis and trade.

Besides, Dr. Paschotta has become an expert in [digital marketing][25] of photonics products. He has
developed the [RP Photonics Buyer's Guide][26] and established it as the premier resource for
finding photonics suppliers.

* who does his best to maintain a very high reputation in all respects, in particular concerning the

## Research Experience
* 01/1992 to 09/1994: doctorate at the [University of Konstanz][39], Germany, in the group of Prof.
J. Mlynek. Obtained the Ph. D. degree with "summa cum laude" (highest distinction) for work in
quantum optics (squeezed light) and nonlinear optics.
* 10/1994 to 01/1997: post-doc in the [Optoelectronics Research Centre][40], Southampton, UK, with
Prof. A. C. Tropper and Prof. D. C. Hanna, working on fiber lasers, upconversion lasers, laser
spectroscopy, laser modeling and simulation, ultrashort pulse generation. After that period, a
fruitful research collaboration was continued for many years with the mentioned persons and others
in the institution.
* 02/1997 to 10/1997: post-doc at the [University of Paderborn][41] (Germany), with Prof. W. Sohler,
working on quasi-phase-matched integrated nonlinear optical devices.
* 11/1997 to 06/2005: leader of a research group in the Institute of Quantum Electronics, [ETH
Zurich][42], within the group of U. Keller, working on all-solid-state picosecond and femtosecond
lasers, mode-locked high-power lasers, mode-locked semiconductor lasers (VECSELs), nonlinear
frequency conversion of ultrashort pulses, laser noise, computer modeling in laser physics and
nonlinear optics.
In her official report of Jan. 2002, concerning R. Paschotta's habilitation, Prof. Keller wrote:
“I consider him as the best scientist in this field within his peer group worldwide and he has
been my best post-doc I have had so far. Presently, he is in charge of eight graduate students in
my group and everybody is speaking very highly of him and enjoys working with him.”
* Since 07/2005: further scientific work (not related to ETH Zurich) while working as a technical
consultant (see below).

## Titles and Honors
* 1987 to 1991 and 1992 to 1994: fellowships of the [Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes][43]
(German National Academic Foundation)
* September 1994: doctoral degree with "summa cum laude" (see above)

regular university teaching as "Privatdozent" (lecturer)

* 2006: R. Paschotta became senior member of [IEEE][47]
* 2012: [R. Paschotta became a fellow of SPIE][48].

## How Hyperspectral Imaging Works

## Hello World,
## we are Cubert!

Since its founding in 2012, Cubert has been a leader in the development of [hyperspectral imaging
technology][25], with a particular focus on snapshot technology that enables real-time data capture.
Unlike conventional hyperspectral camera systems, such as [push-broom sensors][26], our cameras
capture the entire scene instantly, allowing for live data acquisition at video rates.

We recognize the vast potential of our technology, along with the untapped markets and applications
it can unlock. Our goal is to explore these opportunities together with our customers. Thanks to our
innovative approach, we cover a wide range of applications—from research and development to
industrial inspections.

## Our Technology

Cubert is revolutionizing [hyperspectral imaging][33] with cutting-edge [snapshot technology][34]
that enables real-time spectral data capture. Our cameras capture the entire scene in a single
moment, offering a unique combination of speed, flexibility, and precision. With our solutions, you
can analyze spectral information live and at video rates—ideal for applications in research,
industry, and beyond.

Our hyperspectral imaging technology extends imaging far beyond the visible spectrum. Using [light
field technology][35], both the intensity and direction of light are recorded, allowing for advanced
post-processing such as refocusing. This provides comprehensive spectral data for each pixel,
elevating your applications to a new level. We are committed to true [video spectroscopy][36],
seamlessly integrating spectral and spatial data in real-time, opening entirely new possibilities in
imaging.

## **Spectrometers & Photonics Systems** to Measure What
## Matters.

Ocean Optics pioneered miniature spectrometers and delivers spectral solutions to researchers, OEMs
and industrial customers, also designs and builds industrial-grade photonics systems for material
inspection, chemical identification and quality assurance. 

Our mission is to lead in creating precise yet practical optical solutions that enable researchers
and industry to solve meaningful problems in health, safety and the environment. We have discovered,
refined and delivered new approaches to solving problems with spectroscopy and imaging technologies.
Backed by deep experience, we are working within applications
including biomedical, semiconductors, research & science, industrial, environmental, food &
agriculture, and safety & security. 

We partner with customers to achieve ambitious goals, leveraging the power of light for advancement
in health, safety and the environment.

## Use the **Power of Spectroscopy** to Get Results

## Expertise

Leveraging its expertise in visible and infrared hyperspectral imaging, Photon etc. develops
infrared cameras and lenses, hyperspectral imaging systems, preclinical imagers, as well as laser
sources and tunable filters. Renowned for its know-how in complete systems integration, the company
supports research and industry with cutting-edge solutions.

Its technologies are used in a wide range of fields, including small animal imaging, solar cell
characterization, nanotechnology, and industrial sorting. Researchers and industrial partners trust
Photon etc. for accurate analysis and to accelerate innovation, whether it’s developing new
materials, exploring living tissue, or optimizing manufacturing processes.

[Stylized world map with blue location pins connected by dotted lines, representing a global

Si-Ware Systems is a sensing solutions company with multidisciplinary expertise spanning hardware,
software, and systems integration, and deep experience collaborating across global customer and
supplier ecosystems. Backed by a proven track record of delivering both ready-to-deploy products and
co-developed solutions, we support customers and partners in using sensing technologies to solve
complex challenges with speed, precision, and scalability—from early concept to full-scale
production.

Our portfolio brings together today’s offerings and tomorrow’s possibilities with a focus on sensing
domains where our proprietary technologies deliver the greatest impact.

**Material Sensing**
Spectral sensing solutions for identifying, quantifying, and monitoring the composition of
materials, offered as sensors, devices, and complete systems.
[Close-up of two electronic sensor devices with lenses and circuit boards.]

Cloud-based software that connects, manages, and orchestrates sensing devices and data, enabling
actionable insights.
[Computer monitor displaying the CVAS AgriLIMS dashboard with data tables, statistics, and a bar
chart for dry matter analysis of barley sprouts.]
**Turnkey Sensing Solutions**
Integrated hardware and software systems that combine multiple sensing modalities built for
domain-specific applications.
[Orange drone scanning plants in a greenhouse with scan results showing a four-leaf clover on a
smartphone screen.]

## **WHAT **WE DO

## We analyze and identify materials on the spot - anywhere, anytime.

We are on a mission to add value to people's everyday lives with our technological innovations. We
are constantly looking for ways to help our customers solve global problems - ecological and social
aspects are the drivers of our actions.

## **NIRONE ** Scanner Platform

### **Application ** Pharma Security

Fraudulent drugs harm or kill millions around the world. Our NIRONE solution identifies fake
pharmaceuticals within seconds.
[ Learn more ][102]

### **Application ** Product Conformity / Anti-counterfeiting

With our digital material recognition solution, original articles can be tracked and verified within
seconds, without altering or damaging the product.
[ Learn more ][103]

### **Application ** Textile

NIR technology can be applied to textile recycling enabling more efficient sorting with portable
hand-held or built-in scanners.
[ Learn more ][104]

### **Application ** Plastic

Miniaturized and affordable NIR sensors and scanners identify plastics and help sort them more
accurately.
[ Learn more ][105]

## **NIRONE ** SENSOR

Our Near Infrared spectroscopy sensor is innovative, small, robust, inexpensive and intelligent to
bring measurements from laboratories to field use.

[ Read more ][106]

## **TECHNOLOGY**

Our miniaturized, portable and cost-effective solution enables fast, accurate and non-destructive
measurements, taking this technology to the next level.

[ Read more ][107]

## TriOS - Ihr Partner für spektrale Sensoren

### Trinkwasser

Die TriOS Sensoren eignen sich hervorragend für exakte und kontinuierliche Messungen zur Überwachung
der Trinkwasserqualität. Sie liefern verlässliche Messwerte für Stickstoff- und
Kohlenstoffverbindungen und weitere Parameter in der Trinkwasserüberwachung.

[ Mehr erfahren → ][68]

### Abwasser

Die TriOS Sensoren ermöglichen eine präzise und schnelle Analytik der Wasserqualität in
Abwasseranlagen, sowohl für häusliche als auch für industrielle Abwässer. TriOS liefert für jeden
Anwendungsfall den geeigneten Sensor – kompakt, robust, präzise und zuverlässig.

[ Mehr erfahren → ][69]

### Umwelt

TriOS Sensoren werden vielfach für die Überwachung von Gewässern eingesetzt. Sie liefern genau und
in Echtzeit Parameter wie Nitrat, Nitrit, Trübung und Öl in Wasser, und können damit einen
wesentlichen Beitrag zur Erkennung und Reduzierung von Umweltverschmutzungen leisten.

[ Mehr erfahren → ][70]

### Marine

TriOS Sensoren für die Schifffahrt liefern Echtzeitdaten über Nährstoffe, Algenaktivität, Trübung
und gelöste organische Stoffe. Sie sind ideal für den Einsatz in der Aquakultur, der
Umweltforschung, für Offshore-Anwendungen und die umweltfreundliche Emissionskontrolle bei der
Rauchgasreinigung.
[ Mehr erfahren → ][71]

## TriOS – Ihr Partner für spektrale Sensoren

TriOS ist ein langjährig am Markt etablierter Hersteller hochwertiger optischer Messtechnik. Bereits
1998 konnte sich das Unternehmen mit der Entwicklung des ersten, am Markt verfügbaren,
spektralauflösenden Lichtmessgerätes für den Einsatz in der Meeresforschung, RAMSES, einen Namen
machen und sich bis heute zu einem der führenden Hersteller im Bereich der optischen Tauchsensoren
entwickeln. Neben Radiometern bietet TriOS auch Photometer, Fluorometer und diverse andere Sensoren
an und ist somit ein unverzichtbarer Lieferant von hochwertigen Präzisionssonden in der
Gewässergüte, Trink- und Abwasserüberwachung und in vielen Industrieanwendungsgebieten.

## Produkte

[OPUS]
[twturb_web]
Die TriOS Mess- und Datentechnik GmbH stattet bereits seit zwei Jahrzehnten Partner in Wissenschaft
und Naturschutz mit hochqualitativen Messgeräten zur Umwelt- und Wasserüberwachung aus und legt
großen Wert auf den stetigen Austausch mit Forschungspartnern und Anwendern. Die Expertise des
Unternehmens entsteht gerade aus diesem Austausch und einem beständigen Drang nach Wachstum und
Verbesserung. Obwohl unsere Wurzeln in der Radiometrie liegen, konnten wir unser Portfolio mit den
Jahren in die Bereiche Photometrie, Fluorometrie, Nephelometrie und Elektrochemie ausweiten. Hierbei
bieten wir unseren Kunden nicht nur einzelne Messsensoren, sondern ganze Systemkonstruktionen zum
anwendungsgerechten Einsatz in diversen Bereichen an.
[ Übersicht unserer Produkte ][72]

## Einsatzgebiete

### Umwelt- und Wasserüberwachung

TriOS-Sensoren wurden speziell für die Umweltüberwachung in Gewässern entwickelt und liefern präzise
Daten zur Wasserqualität.

### Marine

TriOS-Sensoren erfassen in marinen Anwendungen vielfältige Daten zur Wasserqualität und biologischen
Aktivität.

### Wissenschaft

TriOS Sensoren sind weltweit in der Meeresforschung im Einsatz. Geringes Gewicht sowie sehr
niedriger Stromverbrauch machen sie ideal für den autonomen Einsatz.

### Abwasser & Industrie

TriOS Sensoren ermöglichen eine genaue Überwachung in Abwasseranlagen und messen in Echtzeit. Sie
sind robust und wartungsarm.

# The World, Decoded.

Hidden information, revealed. Critical insights, delivered.
Ultra-miniaturized hyperspectral intelligence, software-defined and built to go anywhere.

## From defence and autonomous systems to the next generation of intelligent devices, Agate Sensors™
## delivers the world's first software-defined hyperspectral platform. Lab-grade, chip-scale,
## mass-manufacturable, and built to unlock entirely new layers of insight across industries.

## Engineered to bring hyperspectral intelligence from the lab to the world.

[Section3_homepage_agatesensors_update]
* REVOLUTIONARY MINIATURIZATION
  Lab-grade hyperspectral precision, previously confined to costly, complex, and bulky scientific
  instruments — now delivered on a single chip.
* SOFTWARE-DEFINED
  One chipset, many applications. Programmable sensing that adapts, evolves, and continuously learns
  — driven by AI after it ships.
* MASS-MANUFACTURABLE
  Material-agnostic and built on mainstream semiconductor processes — hyperspectral sensing designed
  for volume, cost efficiency, and scale.
* SOLID-STATE. ENGINEERED FOR DEMANDING ENVIRONMENTS
  No filters, no gratings, no moving parts — durable, compact, and built to perform where
  conventional hyperspectral systems cannot.

## Imaging Solution

ASI’s comprehensive suite of computer-aided solutions for digital cytogenetics and pathology, cater
to the unique demands of brightfield, fluorescence, and spectral imaging and analysis. With a
steadfast focus on delivering advanced diagnostics and user-centric solutions, ASI stands at the
forefront of technology in karyotyping, IHC and FISH imaging and analysis.

## Who We Are

Applied Spectral Imaging (ASI) boasts a three-decade legacy of innovation in biomedical imaging,
delivering cutting-edge diagnostic solutions to pathology and cytogenetic laboratories.


As a global leader with a network of distribution partners in over 80 countries, ASI values
long-term, personalized customer relationships, **because every diagnosis counts**.

## HAIP Solutions

## Seeing materials beyond the visible

In many industrial and research applications, making the right decision depends on understanding

# Illuminating Invisible Threats

#### The world’s first artificial intelligence-powered spectral data platform

[Get in Touch][36]

## Real-Time Intelligence for What Matters Most

HyperSpectral’s technology combines the power of physics-based spectral data and advanced AI to
deliver rapid, reliable insights in health care and food safety, enabling confident decision-making
that protects lives, reduces costs, and safeguards global health.

[Explore Our Platform][37]

## SpecAI™: Transforming One Industry at a Time

Our first-of-its-kind platform is turning hard scientific data into actionable intelligence,
delivering accurate results on deadly infections in minutes, stopping foodborne illness before it
spreads, ensuring manufacturing quality by uncovering defects, and safeguarding national security by
verifying chip integrity.

### [Health Care][38]

Our technology is revolutionizing health care by delivering real-time, accurate diagnostics on
antibiotic resistant-infections like MRSA and deadly diseases like tuberculosis. With rapid results
and seamless integration, we are improving outcomes and transforming patient care.

### [Food Safety][39]

Our platform is redefining food safety by detecting contamination risks early and preventing
outbreaks before they happen. With rapid, simultaneous testing and real-time results, we are helping
to protect public health and global food systems.

### Quality Control

Our platform is revolutionizing quality control by detecting unique spectral signatures to ensure
the authenticity and integrity of products. By verifying provenance and sourcing — and detecting
adulteration — we help maintain the highest standards of quality.

### Manufacturing

Our platform is transforming manufacturing through data-driven insights that ensure the
authenticity, quality, and integrity of materials and products across diverse industries, empowering
manufacturers to maintain the highest standards while reducing defects and costs.

### Environment

Our technology is advancing environmental monitoring through real-time data on microplastic
contamination in water and detecting harmful greenhouse gas emissions, empowering industries and
governments to reduce pollution, mitigate risks, and safeguard natural resources.

### Defense

Our platform is enhancing defense capabilities by offering precise, rapid threat detection and
analysis. With advanced AI-driven insights, we empower defense teams to identify risks, ensure
mission success, and protect lives with unparalleled accuracy and speed.

[Explore Our Industries][40]

## One Platform, Limitless Potential

Our technology brings physics-based spectral data and advanced AI together in a single,
hardware-agnostic platform that adapts across industries. By turning hard scientific data into
actionable intelligence, our platform expands the boundaries of what AI can do in the physical world
— and what you can achieve in yours. Backed by decades of expertise in AI, spectral science, and
software development, our team is ready to show how SpecAI™ can work for you.

[More About Us][41]

> The advances in the past couple of years in artificial intelligence are allowing us to reimagine
> the age-old technology of spectroscopy for our digital era. We are excited to demonstrate that our
> technology not only works but is faster and cheaper than traditional methods.
> 
> **Matt Theurer**
> HyperSpectral Co-Founder & CEO

## Hyperspectral Imaging Systems

Resonon has been designing and building hyperspectral imaging systems for over 20 years. Our
hyperspectral imagers are used around the world in factories, laboratories, underwater, on the
ground, in the air, and in Low Earth orbit.

Our integrated hardware and software systems produce high-quality data to stimulate new insights and
solve challenging problems. 

Contact us to determine the best system for your application.

at noon and midnight over several days.

##### Measuring Instruments from Konica Minolta Sensing

Find an instrument for your measurement needs, whether measuring the colour of plastic parts, the
colour and gloss of a coating, the Lux values of a lighting installation or the colour and
brightness of a television.

Each of our products is presented with key facts, specifications and a range of purpose designed
accessories that enable you to achieve the most accurate and repeatable measurement data.

[View our Products][14]
[Spectrophotometers with different geometries]
[CM-25cG Measuring Automotive Interior Leather]

##### Find Measurement Solutions by Industry

Our expert teams have implemented thousands of successful measuring instruments in a diverse range
of industries ensuring that our customers can benefit from accurate and traceable data that can help
them to improve quality, reduce waste and cut costs.

Here you can find solutions and example applications specific to your industry and sample types. Our
team will help you to find the right solution for your requirements.

[Solutions by Industry][15]

##### Instrument Service and Maintenance

Our local service centres and field service technicians perform maintenance, repairs and traceable
calibration for Konica Minolta measuring instruments to ensure that customers measure traceable data
all year round with a minimum of downtime.

We have a number of OEM certified facilities throughout Europe and the ability to offer ISO 17025
certifications at our main European Service Centre.

# WHAT IS HYPERSPECTRAL IMAGING?

Hyperspectral imaging is a powerful technology that can reliably identify and sort objects with
similar looks but different chemical compositions, which is impossible with conventional imaging
systems.

[LEARN MORE][31]

# WHY HYPERSPECTRAL IMAGING?

Hyperspectral imaging is a highly accurate research tool and a powerful machine vision technology
for various applications to improve processes, increase quality, and reduce waste.

[LEARN MORE][32]

# REVEALING THE INVISIBLE

[Hyperspectral imaging][33] is an entirely non-destructive, highly accurate, and fast way to
identify different materials or define their properties. Since every material and compound reacts
with light differently, the reflectance measurements result in unique spectral signatures that
identify different materials, similar to fingerprints.

[TUTORIALS][34]

# CHANGING THE WAY WE SEE THE WORLD

[HUMAN EYE / RGB][HYPERSPECTRAL]

Hyperspectral imaging has been done inside Pharao’s tomb, under the ice, flying over an ancient
Roman city. It is used extensively in research and industry to identify, locate, sort, and quantify
different materials that are invisible to the human eye.

# Trusted for 50 Years in Optical Properties Characterization

Surface Optics offers a single engineering and manufacturing source for solutions requiring the
application, characterization, or control of the optical properties of surfaces.

Founded in 1977 to provide optical property measurement services, today Surface Optics Corporation
(SOC) specializes in advanced imaging systems, scientific instruments and thin film vacuum coatings
for surface engineering.

SOC is pioneering innovative solutions for our research, aerospace, defense, semiconductor,
automotive, and energy customers worldwide.

internationally. Whether you are seeking equipment, expertise, or subcontracting for your optical
systems projects, Telops/Exosens is dedicated to surpassing your high expectations and transforming
them into successful outcomes.

Telops’ global presence is strengthened by an efficient worldwide network of distribution and
representative agents. The company understands the significance of accessibility and customer
support, aiming to provide seamless experiences for clients regardless of their location.

Passion drives Telops, now known as Exosens, and it takes pride in exceeding expectations. Customers
trust Telops/Exosens for its technical expertise, exceptional product quality, and unwavering

processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

materials.

for mobile devices.
